messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "about 4 days: acid-lowering effect reaches maximum with once-daily dosing"
set: ["about 4 days: acid-lowering effect reaches maximum with once-daily dosing", "once-daily dosing", "around 2 hours: strongest acid-lowering effect", "about 4 years", "1 to 4 days: most people feel full benefit", "maximum dose", "once-daily extended-release tablet", "can take several days of regular once-daily use before full effect", "about 4 hours after taking", "about a week of once daily dosing", "avoid talking for about 5 minutes after dosing", "side effect", "full effect for depression may take 4 weeks or longer", "alternate day dosing", "measure each dose with the oral dosing syringe", "measure liquid medicine with the dosing syringe provided"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
